rule: Post-merge decision report is opt-in and OFF by default
description: P3 coupling. The post-merge decision report is gated on the operator key `HIVEMIND_ENABLE_DECISION_REPORT`, checked by PRESENCE, and the DEFAULT (unset or empty) is OFF. Pins are divided per rule 3 of the pin-authoring contract: the CANONICAL file `plugin/governance/decision-autonomy.md` carries every behavioral claim, and the agent CONSUMER carries a POINTER-only assertion. The source pin sits on ONE span carrying BOTH halves of the gate's conditional: the discriminating condition (the key is unset or empty — the DEFAULT) and the whole obligation it triggers (the deferred-report scan renders no report, NEVER invokes `hivemind:decision-report`, and makes NO GitHub call of any kind). Either half alone is rewritable while the other stays green — deleting the `unset or empty — the DEFAULT` keying flips the gate to opt-out, and deleting the no-GitHub-call clause re-admits a PR-state lookup on the off path — so both live inside the pinned span. Two further canonical claims are pinned as separate entries against the same canonical file, because each fails independently of the source span. The first is the key's identity: its NAME, its operator-config CHANNEL (the `env` block of `.claude/settings.json` committed or `.claude/settings.local.json` gitignored), and the PRESENCE test itself, pinned as one span — renaming the key, relocating its home, or swapping the presence test for a value comparison each changes what the gate IS, and the presence fragment alone is ambiguous with the sibling `HIVEMIND_SKIP_PR_WATCH` presence rule in this repo. The second is the off path's idempotency obligation: the overlord derives the same awaiting-report set from the same predicate and `touch`es the zero-byte `.decision-report-done` marker WITHOUT checking PR state. That entry is separate because the unconditional-marker rule and the renders-nothing rule fail independently — the scan could keep rendering nothing while silently reading PR state to decide whether to mark, which would re-introduce exactly the GitHub call the gate exists to remove. The agent consumer `plugin/agents/overlord.md` is pinned in POINTER shape ONLY: the agent names the canonical `decision-autonomy.md` (Post-Merge Decision Report Trigger) section and says it is not restated there, so severing the agent site from the canonical rule is loud while honest rewording of the agent's surrounding scan prose — its environment, ordering, and marker phrasing — is NOT punished. The section name is pinned only inside that full pointer sentence, never bare, because the bare parenthetical recurs elsewhere in the same file. What this fixture honestly guarantees is exactly that these word sequences exist in these two named files; it claims nothing about meaning and nothing about runtime behavior. Residuals, stated plainly: (1) a presence pin proves the off-path rules are still WRITTEN DOWN, never that the overlord actually skips the GitHub call, renders nothing, or touches the marker at runtime; (2) a meaning-preserving rewrite-around is invisible — surrounding prose that re-enables the report by default, or that re-introduces a PR-state read on the off path, while leaving the pinned bytes intact stays green; (3) the agent consumer is pinned only at its pointer, so the agent could restate the gate incorrectly beside an intact pointer and stay green — that is the deliberate price of rule 3, which trades byte-level consumer coverage for a suite that does not break on truthful rewording; (4) the contributor-facing `CLAUDE.md` paragraph describing the key is deliberately UNPINNED, because that file carries no pointer to the canonical section and a pin there could only be copied claim prose, which rule 3 forbids; (5) the pin sees only the two files it names, so a third surface describing the key differently is outside its reach; (6) a NEW consumer — another agent, skill, or workflow that invokes the decision report and never carries the gate at all — is an ABSENCE defect that no fixture in this directory can detect per rule 7 of the pin-authoring contract; catching it needs a structural check in `tools/policy_check.sh`, not a presence pin.

source.pattern: When `HIVEMIND_ENABLE_DECISION_REPORT` is unset or empty — the DEFAULT — the deferred-report scan renders no report, NEVER invokes `hivemind:decision-report`, and makes NO GitHub call of any kind

consumers.pattern: The report is CONFIG-GATED on `HIVEMIND_ENABLE_DECISION_REPORT`, set in the `env` block of the project's `.claude/settings.json` (committed) or `.claude/settings.local.json` (gitignored) — the same operator-override channel as `HIVEMIND_SKIP_PR_WATCH` and `HIVEMIND_LOCAL_REVIEW_MODEL`. Check it by PRESENCE with a simple non-empty test

When the key is UNSET or EMPTY, the overlord derives the same awaiting-report set from the same predicate and, for each run in it, `touch`es the zero-byte `.decision-report-done` marker WITHOUT checking PR state
The canonical policy is `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/decision-autonomy.md` (Post-Merge Decision Report Trigger) and is not restated here.
